title: Asking for Help
subtitle: Getting assistance from a stranger — for English learners

sentences.en: Excuse me, could you help me for a minute?
sentences.target: Excuse me, could you help me for a minute?

sentences.en: I think I'm lost. I'm trying to find my hotel.
sentences.target: I think I'm lost. I'm trying to find my hotel.

sentences.en: What's the name of the hotel?
sentences.target: What's the name of the hotel?

sentences.en: It's called the Grand Plaza Hotel, on Fifth Street.
sentences.target: It's called the Grand Plaza Hotel, on Fifth Street.

sentences.en: Oh, I know that one. It's only a few blocks from here.
sentences.target: Oh, I know that one. It's only a few blocks from here.

sentences.en: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
sentences.target: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?

sentences.en: Of course. Walk to the corner and then turn left.
sentences.target: Of course. Walk to the corner and then turn left.

sentences.en: Thank you so much for helping me.
sentences.target: Thank you so much for helping me.

sentences.en: You're welcome. Have a good day!
sentences.target: You're welcome. Have a good day!
